name: Zared
overview: Zared, also called Zered, is identified in Scripture as a brook or valley that marked a significant point during the Israelites' wilderness journey. According to Numbers 21:12 and Deuteronomy 2:13-14, the people encamped in the valley of Zared and crossed over the brook Zered after wandering for thirty-eight years following their departure from Kadeshbarnea. This location symbolizes a pivotal moment in God's fulfillment of His promise to lead the generation of men of war out of the wilderness.
